title: Hackers Spied on a Stock Exchange Executive's Outlook Mailbox for Five Months

title: WhatsApp, Slack Notifications Could Hijack Google Gemini on Android
summary: A single poisoned notification from WhatsApp, Slack, SMS, Signal, Instagram, or Messenger could have hijacked Google Gemini's voice assistant on Android and made it open a victim's connected windows, fake a message from their boss, push the phone into a Zoom call, or quietly poison its long-term memory.
